items.summary: Target is back in focus after analysts raised their fair value estimate from about US$133.84 to roughly US$162.76, a move that aligns with a wave of higher price targets across Wall Street. This shift follows Q2 research that has become more constructive, with firms debating how much of Target's merchandising and traffic recovery is already reflected in the stock.
